acceptanceCriteria: testvaliditydoc.EvidenceDirectory is defined as testevidence.EvidenceDirectory (or removed in favour of it)
The pin test is removed or kept as a trivial guard; focused testevidence and testvaliditydoc tests pass
body: Residual from V1-1811 (PR #1151). To break an import cycle, testevidence became a leaf package with its own EvidenceDirectory, which duplicates testvaliditydoc.EvidenceDirectory and is held equal only by TestEvidenceDirectoryMatchesDiscovery. Expected: one source of truth, with testvaliditydoc aliasing testevidence.EvidenceDirectory.
title: Two EvidenceDirectory constants: testevidence duplicates testvaliditydoc
